graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> List of all vertex identifiers in the graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Each entry is a pair [u, v] representing an undirected edge between vertex u and vertex v.

vertex_weights: <list[int], length num_vertices> Weight assigned to each vertex, where the i-th entry is the weight of vertex i.
